purpose: Order 117 hypothesis-2 A/B: expose a reusable, model-parameterized ZIP create/extract action and preserve verified document-conversion paths in the next model context so the Agent can complete a convert-then-package workflow without repeating conversion.
change_scope: Preserve the v122 prompt, model, runtime limits, VM, evaluator, generic-only boundary, and model-owned arguments. Add archive.create_extract as a flat Multi-Apps facade over an OS Adapter action whose mode, archive_path, input_paths, base_directory, destination_directory, and overwrite policy all come from the captured model call. ZIP creation is transactional and verifies persisted members; extraction rejects absolute paths, traversal, backslashes, duplicate names, encrypted entries, and symbolic links before writing. Add compact truthful context for document.convert_batch and archive.create_extract. No task identity, instruction fingerprint, fixed input/output filename, answer, golden content, evaluator state, Runner rerouting, or argument rewriting participates.

protocol.runner_guard_terminal_semantics: Internal guard termination records the reason and invokes the original evaluator without appending OSWorld FAIL; explicit model fail_task remains OSWorld FAIL.
protocol.on_failure: Preserve and strictly audit this hypothesis-2 A/B, classify the new failure, and do not rerun it unchanged. Try at most one further materially different generic hypothesis with one targeted A/B. If hypothesis 3 also fails, mark Order 117 task_blocked and immediately advance to Order 118.

implementation_evidence.parent_attempt_diagnosis: v122 made document.convert_batch truthful and verified: the first conversion completed at step 2 with status=ok and verification_passed=true. The model nevertheless repeated conversion because LiteAgent discarded matched and converted paths as downstream_context=null. It later read both available documents but never created a ZIP because no deterministic archive action existed in the public OS or Multi-Apps tool surface. The no-progress guard stopped the 30-step run; original evaluator reward was 0.0 and strict audit valid=true with zero leakage or argument rewriting.
